title: One Hand One Bounce (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son. One hand. One bounce. OUT.
The rules committee has spoken.
That committee is me.

[Verse 1]
Fielder catches it one-handed after one bounce on the turf
You are walking son, that is the backyard rules worth
One hand, one bounce, clean as the catch
One hand one bounce, and the fielder has your match

Leather hits the grass once, that is the bounce
Fielder scoops one-handed, and your innings is pounced
No slips to wait for, no keeper glovework
One hand one bounce, that is where the fielding does not shirk

[Pre-Chorus]
One bounce on the ground
One hand is sound
That is out, that is done
One hand one bounce

[Chorus]
One hand one bounce, you are walking mate
One hand one bounce, no debate
The ball hits the turf and the hand comes down
One hand one bounce, that is the law in this town

[Verse 2]
Fielding positions in a backyard game
Short leg is the letter box, cover point is the drain
Anywhere the boundary touches fence is four
One hand one bounce anywhere, that is the law

[Bridge]
Bluey: OH HE HAS TAKEN IT, one hand, one bounce, incredible athleticism from the deep
Trevor: Technically within the One Hand One Bounce covenant, incontestable dismissal
Chas: I wrote the covenant. On a piece of paper. In 1987. It still stands.

[Chorus]
One hand one bounce, you are walking mate
One hand one bounce, no debate
The ball hits the turf and the hand comes down
One hand one bounce, that is the law in this town

[Outro]
Dont argue it son
The covenant stands
Thats my boy
